name: image_flux3_klein_distilled_t2i
description: FLUX 3 Image Klein text-to-image, step-distilled checkpoint: BFL's open-weights 5.6B image model at 16 euler/simple steps, cfg 1. The everyday Klein template. Pipeline mirrors ComfyUI's official image_flux3_klein_distilled_t2i template with its subgraph flattened: int8-convrot diffusion model, Qwen3-VL 4B int8 text encoder (CLIPLoader type flux3), Flux 2 VAE, and the official Qwen3.5 9B prompt upsampler (TextGenerate with BFL's system prompt) switchable via prompt_upsampling. Output is sized by a ResolutionSelector (aspect_ratio picks the shape, resolution the megapixel budget, multiples of 16). Fits a 16 GB GPU: ComfyUI loads the 5.8 GB diffusion model, 4.9 GB encoder and 6.7 GB upsampler one at a time. The bounding-box layout branch of the official template is left out. ~17.7 GB of model downloads; run check_requirements / download_models first. Shares the text encoder, upsampler and VAE with every other image_flux3_klein_* template. Weights are gated on Hugging Face under the FLUX Kommunity License (free commercial use only below US$5M annual revenue): accept the license at huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy and set HF_TOKEN before download_models. Needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer.
expected_duration: 30-90 seconds on a 16GB GPU (prompt upsampling is most of it)

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate. With prompt upsampling on, a short request is fine; with it off, write a full scene caption (framing, subject, background, lighting).

prompt_upsampling.description: Run the prompt through the official Qwen3.5 9B FLUX 3 prompt upsampler before encoding (default 'on', as BFL recommends: short prompts give generic results without it). 'off' encodes your text verbatim and skips loading the 6.7 GB upsampler, which saves time when you already wrote a full, detailed scene caption.

resolution.description: Output size, as the megapixel budget the ResolutionSelector spends on the chosen aspect ratio: '1mp' = 1024x1024 square (default), '2mp' = ~1440x1440, '4mp' = ~2048x2048. Non-square ratios keep the same pixel budget. Time and VRAM scale with it.

steps.description: Sampler steps (default 16, BFL's recommendation for the distilled checkpoint; useful range 4-16). Fewer steps are faster but softer.

seed.description: Sampler seed, for reproducing an earlier generation. Omit it and a fresh random seed is used on every submission.
